subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: I can say the sound /w/ for wh and /f/ for ph.
I can write wh or ph to complete words.
I can read and write the tricky word go.

tf.s: The letters wh make the /w/ sound in whale.
The letters ph make the /p/ sound in phone.
Dolphin has the letters ph in it.
Wheel starts with the letters ph.
Fish and phone start with the same sound.
tf.why: Both start with /f/, but with different letters.

tf.s: Elephant and alphabet have the /f/ sound with ph.
tf.why: Great! Ph says /f/ in both words.
White starts with wh, the /w/ sound.

tf.s: The tongue twister says: The dolphin has got a wheel and the whale has got a phone.
tf.why: It's the whale with a wheel and the dolphin with a phone.

tf.s: We say I go to bed at eight o'clock.
tf.why: We use go with bed, school, home and the shop.

boxes.why: Dolphin has ph in the middle.

boxes.q: What is the first sound in wheel?
Complete: I ___ home at two o'clock.
What sound does ph make in alphabet?
In the tongue twister, who has got a phone?
boxes.why: The dolphin has got a phone.

mcq.q: Which word has the /f/ sound with ph?

o: The whale has got a wheel and the dolphin has got a phone.
The whale has got a phone and the dolphin has got a wheel.
The elephant has got a wheel.
The dolphin has got a whale.
mcq.why: Whale with a wheel, dolphin with a phone.

mcq.q: How do you spell the tricky word?

mcq.why: We ask When do you go ...?

mcq.q: Make a sentence: I / school / morning
o: I go to school in the morning.
I to go school in the morning.
I go in school the morning.
mcq.why: I go to school in the morning.

mcq.q: Your teacher says a word with /f/ but it has ph. Which word is it?
Fish and phone start with the same sound. What is different?
Which group has only ph words?
mcq.why: Phone, dolphin and elephant all have ph.

mcq.q: Which group has only words with the /w/ sound from wh?
mcq.why: Whale, wheel and wheat start with wh.
